laws.rule: Severe penalties for even small amounts of illegal drugs. A personal supply of a controlled drug (for example methylphenidate for ADHD, codeine or morphine) has specific legal requirements: check with the Ministry of Health before travel.

Sale and import of vapes and e-cigarettes are banned. Visitors over 21 may bring one device and up to 30 ml of e-liquid, and must take it with them or surrender it to the Ministry of Health on departure.
Drive on an Australian licence for up to 6 months, only vehicles your licence covers. A scooter needs a temporary motorbike licence: a practical test at police headquarters in Avarua.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Modest dress and behaviour, especially outside resorts, in villages and on the outer islands. Visitors are welcome at Sunday services: shirts and long trousers for men, longer skirts or dresses for women, shoulders covered. Cook Islands Tourism: dress modestly in villages, town and churches. For Sunday service, men wear a shirt and long trousers; women wear a dress or skirt to the knee or longer, with shoulders covered. Visitors are welcome at services. No topless or nude sunbathing. On Mitiaro, no photos during Sunday service.

tourism.detail: Tourism and family visits; extendable on application.

meetings.detail: Short business visits need no visa in advance.

conference.detail: Short business visits need no visa in advance.

unpaid-speaking.route: Visitor entry (short business visit) or Work permit
unpaid-speaking.detail: Speaking at a business conference fits a business visit; other speaking may count as work.
unpaid-speaking.next: Ask the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration before travel.

paid-speaking.detail: A bona fide visitor can't work or study; paid work needs a worker permit or another status that allows it.
paid-speaking.next: Ask the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration through the host.

book-launch.detail: Working on a visitor permit isn't allowed; a work permit needs a confirmed place of work or a business being set up.
book-launch.next: Ask the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration before travel.

ai-teaching.next: Ask the Ministry through the host.

remote-work.route: Visitor permit (up to 8 months for non-New Zealanders)
remote-work.detail: Visitor permits prohibit work for gain or reward; remote work for a foreign employer is not addressed.
remote-work.next: Ask Cook Islands Immigration in writing.

entrepreneur.detail: Exploring opportunities fits a business visit; running a business needs the business or work route.
entrepreneur.next: Ask the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration before travel.

trade.detail: Meetings and negotiation are business visits; delivering work is not.
trade.next: Ask the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration before travel.

artist.next: Ask the Ministry through the host.

mixed-mission.detail: Visitor, business and work routes each cover different parts.
mixed-mission.next: Ask the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration before travel.

filming.detail: No filming permit process was found. Event filming (for example at Te Maeva Nui) may need the organisers' agreement.
filming.next: Ask the Ministry of Cultural Development.

research.detail: Research approved and funded by a university or research organisation uses its own permit (up to three years, not extendable), not visitor entry; it doesn't allow working for gain.
research.next: Apply through the Ministry with the research body's approval.

volunteering.next: Ask the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration.

items.text: There are specific legal requirements that need to be met in order to bring into the Cook Islands a personal supply of a Controlled Drug (for example medicines for ADHD such as methylphenidate or strong pain medicines, such as codeine or morphine).
Penalties for carrying or using even small amounts of illegal drugs are severe.
The Cook Islands has banned the sale or importation of imitation tobacco products, including vapes/e-cigarettes.
Visitors over the age of 21 are allowed to bring one e-imitation tobacco device and up to 30 millilitres of e-liquid.
